question: Which additional types are included in the continuing enumeration of forms?
premises: One type is the triple-staff bearer
Another type is the seller of the Veda
These are added to the sequence
inference: The enumeration further includes the triple-staff bearer and the seller of the Veda.
uncertainties: The form deveśas appears nominative but functions as a vocative address
plain_english: O Lord of gods, there is also the triple-staff bearer, and likewise another, the seller of the Veda.
